strings.objective.get_bearings: Get your bearings. The lesson has not started.
strings.objective.check_bag: Find your biology textbook. Check your bag.
strings.objective.outside: You are outside. Nothing asks you to be anywhere.
strings.objective.residential: The road goes on towards the flats.
strings.objective.animal: Something green is standing on the concrete.
strings.overlay.expect_body: Nothing in this has happened. It is what you imagine.
strings.overlay.deny_body: The bell has not rung. Nobody has come in.
strings.objective.bell: Second bell. The lesson is starting.
strings.objective.no_textbook: No textbook. Look around before the second bell. You can glance at the corridor if you like.
strings.end.slice.title: End of this build
strings.end.slice.body: You are past the school, on the street, and among the flats. The alley behind the animal, the gate out of the estate, and the courtyard it is walking towards are the next thing to build.
strings.objective.alley: A narrow way between the flats.
strings.objective.estate_gate: The estate gate. The playground is beyond it.
strings.objective.playground: The playground. Nothing is making you hurry.
strings.objective.playground_done: You have looked around the playground.
strings.end.playground.title: End of this build
strings.end.playground.body: You have reached the playground and looked around. The places beyond the fence are not yet built.
strings.ability.keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
strings.ability.keen_eye.desc: Notices details others miss. Precise, a little detached.
strings.ability.recollection.name: Recollection
strings.ability.recollection.desc: Incomplete memories that surface when they choose to. Uncertain, associative.
strings.ability.gut_feeling.name: Gut Feeling
strings.ability.gut_feeling.desc: An impression before a reason. Urgent, impressionistic.
strings.ability.steadiness.name: Steadiness
strings.ability.steadiness.desc: Keeps you grounded when things shift. Calm, grounding.
strings.passive.keen_eye.hook: Something about that doesn't sit right.
strings.passive.recollection.hook: You have seen something like that before, or think you have.
strings.passive.gut_feeling.hook: A feeling, before you can say why.
